SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT NVL(WERKS,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(EBELN,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(EBELP,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(MBLNR,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, NVL(ZEILE,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM ZKEP_GR WHERE iflag = '1'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'MHWA' AS BUYER, NVL(WERKS,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(EBELN,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(EBELP,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, NVL(MATNR,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(WAERS,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(NETPR*100, 0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(MENGE, 0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(NETWR*100, 0) AS GR_AMT, NVL(BUDAT,' ') AS GR_DATE, ' ' AS LEGACY_PR_NO, NVL(MBLNR,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, NVL(ZEILE,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, NVL(LGORT,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(ITMTXT,' ') AS REMARK, NVL(IFLAG,' ') AS IF_FLAG, NVL(IDATE,' ') AS IF_DATE, NVL(ITIME,' ') AS IF_TIME FROM ZKEP_GR WHERE IFLAG = '1' AND WERKS = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND EBELN = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND EBELP = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND MBLNR = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND ZEILE = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' ORDER BY WERKS, MBLNR,ZEILE, EBELN,EBELP
UPDATE ZKEP_GR SET IFLAG = '2', IDATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), ITIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE IFLAG = '1' AND WERKS = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND EBELN = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND EBELP = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND MBLNR = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND ZEILE = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$'
